newsitem.title: USA: Fletcher files for $450 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher files for $450 mln shelf debt.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Ltd filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of $450 million in debt securities.
When combined with a previous filing, Fletcher will have a $800 million in debt securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures and other corporate purposes, including repayment of debt, Fletcher said in the filing.
Fletcher Challenge is an Auckland, New Zealand-based international company that operates in four core industries: paper, energy, building and soild wood plantation forestry.
